fitness_plan.plan_summary: This training plan focuses on building lean muscle through a combination of compound exercises and targeted accessory work. It incorporates a 3-day split, prioritizing major muscle groups each session with moderate volume and intensity to stimulate hypertrophy. Recovery is emphasized through active recovery and nutrition.

movements.name: Barbell Bench Press
movements.coaching_notes: Focus on controlled descent and explosive press.

movements.name: Overhead Press
movements.coaching_notes: Maintain a stable core and controlled movement.

movements.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
movements.coaching_notes: Squeeze your chest at the top of the movement.

movements.name: Lateral Raises
movements.coaching_notes: Focus on feeling the deltoids working.

training_days.conditioning_or_cardio: 20 minutes of incline walking at a moderate pace.
training_days.recovery: Light stretching and foam rolling of upper body.

movements.name: Calf Raises
movements.coaching_notes: Squeeze the calves at the top.

training_days.recovery: Active recovery: light walk and lower body stretching.

movements.name: Pull-Ups
movements.coaching_notes: Use assisted pull-up machine if needed.

movements.name: Bent-Over Row
movements.coaching_notes: Maintain a flat back and controlled movement.

movements.name: Lat Pulldowns
movements.coaching_notes: Focus on squeezing the shoulder blades together.

movements.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
movements.coaching_notes: Control the eccentric phase of the movement.

training_days.recovery: Foam rolling and upper body stretching.

fitness_plan.recovery_notes: Prioritize sleep, aim for 7-9 hours per night. Incorporate active recovery such as light stretching and walking on off days to promote blood flow and reduce muscle soreness.
fitness_plan.nutrition_notes: Consume a balanced diet with adequate protein intake (around 1.6-2.2g per kg of body weight) to support muscle growth. Focus on whole foods and stay hydrated throughout the day.
